scope: Analytic exclusion of order-41 omega=5 row R under the standing row-R hypotheses only; no catalogue-completeness, order-41 closure, Erdos 151 solution, UNSAT, Git, publication, novelty, or priority claim

binding_policy.rule: This JSON binds the completed audit Markdown and audited inputs but intentionally omits its own hash.

proof_audit.claim: S_c=N(c) is a maximum ambient-admissible nine-set
proof_audit.reason: Every nontrivial clique in an open neighbourhood extends by its centre, and row R gives |N(c)|=4+5=9=beta(G).

proof_audit.claim: Each exact singleton fibre P_c(a) has size at most one
proof_audit.reason: The bad ten-set forces ua to be an ambient-maximal edge. If uv is present, v extends ua with a; if uv is absent, replacing a by u,v gives an admissible ten-set.

proof_audit.claim: Each cut e(U,A_c) is at least 17
proof_audit.reason: Domination gives eleven nonempty neighbour sets, at most five of which are singleton fibres, so the incidence count is at least 5+2*6=17.
Every independent set in the induced residual F_c is F_c-admissible and beta(F_c)=5.

proof_audit.claim: Turan/complement extremum gives e(U)>=7 with unique equality type K3 disjoint-union 4K2
proof_audit.reason: The complement is K6-free, ex(11,K6)=48, and equality is the balanced T_5(11).

proof_audit.claim: The global U-degree identity and degree ceiling force equality throughout
proof_audit.reason: 2e(U)+sum cuts=sum d_U<=99 while the independent lower bounds total 2*7+5*17=99.

proof_audit.claim: The terminal transversal lemma gives beta(F_c)>=6
proof_audit.reason: F-maximal edges from a have an independent endpoint set L_a in W; a transversal avoiding L_a together with a contains no nontrivial F-maximal clique. Isolated a and absent edges are included.

cut_set_system.method: Dynamic programming over eleven labelled vertices, 31 nonempty subsets of a five-set, and a five-bit used-singleton mask
cut_set_system.equality_structure: five distinctly labelled singletons and six doubletons

turan_equality_graph_search.method: Independent SAT projection enumeration on 55 edge variables, with one edge-cover clause for every six-subset

terminal_direct_maximal_clique_search.method: For every neighbourhood of one outside vertex in K3 disjoint-union 4K2, exhaust all maximal cliques and all vertex subsets of the induced 12-vertex graph
terminal_direct_maximal_clique_search.relation_to_source: Stronger than the beta>=6 terminal lemma; induced-to-ambient maximality transfers the witness to any larger residual.
